title: Consolidate short-lived job clusters into shared or reused job clusters
description: Dozens of job clusters using node type Standard_F4 are created and terminated within ~7–9 minutes each. Repeated startup overhead (driver + workers + Databricks Units) significantly increases cost relative to actual compute work. Using a shared job cluster or enabling cluster reuse for sequential tasks would reduce DBU and VM startup costs.

title: Evaluate downsizing Standard_F4 node type for lightweight jobs
description: All job clusters use Standard_F4 nodes despite very short runtimes, suggesting the workloads may be lightweight. If CPU and memory utilization is low, switching to a smaller node type (e.g., F2 or equivalent) would lower per-hour VM and DBU costs without impacting performance.

title: Terminate or strictly auto-terminate idle interactive cluster
description: The interactive cluster 'playground' ran for an extremely long duration (from start_time 1768242839157 to terminated_time 1769671888979). Even with zero workers, the driver and DBUs incur continuous cost. Enforcing aggressive auto-termination or replacing with ephemeral clusters would reduce idle spend.
estimated_savings: Up to 100% of idle interactive cluster cost

title: Deduplicate log ingestion to improve cost attribution and governance
description: The same cluster and job run records appear multiple times with different load_timestamp values, indicating duplicated ingestion. While not a direct compute cost, this inflates storage and makes accurate cost analysis difficult, potentially masking real cost leaks.

title: Reduce job cluster churn by reusing clusters
description: Hundreds of job clusters were created for the same job (job_id 229907899455689), each running for ~6–8 minutes on average. This pattern incurs repeated cluster startup costs (VM provisioning + Databricks DBUs) that can outweigh actual compute time. Using a shared job cluster or enabling cluster reuse for sequential runs would significantly reduce overhead.

title: Downsize node type for short-running workloads
description: All job clusters use Standard_F4 nodes regardless of very short execution durations (<10 minutes). For lightweight ETL or orchestration-style jobs, smaller VM types (e.g., Standard_F2 or autoscaling with min=1) are typically sufficient and cheaper.

title: Eliminate duplicate log ingestion to avoid analysis overhead
description: The same cluster records appear multiple times with different load_timestamps, indicating duplicate ingestion of cluster logs. While not a direct Databricks compute cost, this inflates downstream storage and analytics costs and can mislead optimization decisions.

title: Enforce auto-termination on long-lived UI clusters
description: The UI cluster 'playground' (Standard_D4ds_v5) ran for an extremely long duration before termination, despite having zero workers. This is a classic idle cost scenario and should be controlled with aggressive auto-termination policies.
estimated_savings: Up to 100% of idle cluster cost
